Guide a skiff through a drowned ruin, recover three tide shards, and reach the bell gate before the tide window closes. The new **Tideglass** pulse briefly hushes currents and protects you from sentries; shifting currents and roaming hazards add the fresh challenge. Includes keyboard and touch controls, hull damage, sound toggle, and win/lose/restart states.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to use Tideglass, R to restart. On mobile, use the on-screen controls.
